senses.en: to allow someone to enter a place or join a school
senses.pattern: be admitted to a university / be admitted to a club / admit sb into the building
senses.example: Only two hundred students are [[admitted]] to the medical school each year, so competition is extremely fierce.
senses.example_zh: 這所醫學院每年只錄取兩百名學生，所以競爭極為激烈。
senses.note: 名詞 admission＝入學許可；入場費

senses.en: to take someone into a hospital for treatment
senses.pattern: be admitted to (the) hospital / admit a patient / be admitted for surgery
senses.example: After fainting during the race, the runner was [[admitted]] to the hospital for further tests.
senses.example_zh: 那名跑者在比賽中昏倒後，被收治住院做進一步檢查。

gsat.sentence: She was then [[admitted]] to a hospital for treatment, where she was able to recover.

senses.en: an act of appearing in public or arriving somewhere
senses.pattern: make an appearance / a public appearance / a TV appearance / first appearance
senses.example: The singer made a surprise [[appearance]] at the charity concert, and the crowd went wild.
senses.example_zh: 那位歌手在慈善音樂會上驚喜露面，全場觀眾為之瘋狂。
senses.note: to all appearances＝從表面上看

gsat.sentence: As a shy boy afraid of making public [[appearances]], Timmy dreads the thought of speaking before large audiences.
It has been a market favorite since its first [[appearance]].

senses.en: ordinary; not special or especially good
senses.pattern: the average person / an average student / of average ability / just average
senses.example: The food at the new restaurant was only [[average]], but the service was warm and friendly.
senses.example_zh: 那家新餐廳的菜色很普通，但服務親切又友善。

senses.en: to be or do a certain amount as an average
senses.pattern: average eight hours a day / average 20 points a game / average 50 km an hour
senses.example: Teenagers in the survey [[averaged]] only six hours of sleep on school nights.
senses.example_zh: 調查中的青少年在上學日的晚上平均只睡六小時。
senses.note: 後面直接接數量，不加介系詞

gsat.sentence: For the [[average]] person, however, water remains a very good option for keeping hydrated—if you know how to drink it.

senses.en: to defeat or do better than someone
senses.pattern: best an opponent / best a rival / be bested by
senses.example: After a tense final round, the young chess player [[bested]] a champion twice her age.
senses.example_zh: 經過緊張的最後一輪，這位年輕棋手擊敗了年紀大她一倍的冠軍。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 bested；較正式

senses.en: having no money at all
senses.pattern: be flat broke / go broke / be completely broke
senses.example: I can't join the trip this weekend because I'm completely [[broke]] until payday.
senses.example_zh: 這個週末的旅行我去不了，因為在發薪日之前我完全沒錢。
senses.note: 口語用法；不放在名詞前

gsat.sentence: She didn’t have any insurance, so she went [[broke]] because of her illness.

senses.en: an upper limit on prices, wages, or spending
senses.pattern: a price ceiling / set a ceiling on / raise the debt ceiling
senses.example: The government set a [[ceiling]] on rent increases to protect families from losing their homes.
senses.example_zh: 政府為租金漲幅設定上限，以免許多家庭失去住處。
senses.note: glass ceiling＝（升遷的）無形障礙

senses.en: (of a disaster or disease) to cause someone's death
senses.pattern: claim lives / claim the life of / claim many victims
senses.example: The disease [[claimed]] the lives of many farm animals before a vaccine was finally developed.
senses.example_zh: 在疫苗終於研發出來之前，這種疾病奪走了許多農場動物的性命。

senses.en: to ask for something you have a right to
senses.pattern: claim a refund / claim compensation / claim lost luggage / claim a prize
senses.example: Passengers whose flights are canceled can [[claim]] a full refund within thirty days.
senses.example_zh: 班機遭取消的旅客可在三十天內申請全額退款。
senses.note: 名詞：an insurance claim＝保險理賠申請

gsat.sentence: The lonely “wind phone” serves to connect family members to their departed loved ones who died in the tsunami that [[claimed]] 18,000 lives.
When he was nine, the country’s civil war [[claimed]] the life of his mother and left him homeless.

senses.en: the fact of being with someone; people you are with
senses.pattern: keep sb company / enjoy sb's company / in the company of / good company
senses.example: I enjoyed her [[company]] on the long train ride, and the six hours passed quickly.
senses.example_zh: 漫長的火車旅程有她陪伴很愉快，六個小時一下就過了。
senses.note: 此義不可數；have company＝有客人

senses.en: a group of actors or dancers who perform together
senses.pattern: a theater company / a dance company / a touring company
senses.example: At eighteen, she joined a ballet [[company]] and performed on stages in over twenty countries.
senses.example_zh: 她十八歲時加入一個芭蕾舞團，在二十多個國家登台演出。

senses.en: a tall machine used for lifting heavy things
senses.pattern: a construction crane / a tower crane / operate a crane / lift by crane
senses.example: A huge [[crane]] lifted the steel beams onto the roof of the new stadium.
senses.example_zh: 一台巨大的起重機把鋼梁吊到新體育場的屋頂上。
senses.note: 因外形像鶴的長頸而得名

senses.en: to stretch your neck to see something better
senses.pattern: crane one's neck / crane one's neck to see / crane one's neck for a better view
senses.example: Fans at the back [[craned]] their necks to catch a glimpse of the singer on stage.
senses.example_zh: 後排的歌迷伸長脖子，想看一眼舞台上的歌手。

senses.en: to talk too proudly about your own success
senses.pattern: crow about / crow over a victory / nothing to crow about
senses.example: He kept [[crowing]] about his perfect score until his classmates stopped listening to him.
senses.example_zh: 他不停誇耀自己考滿分，直到同學都不想再聽。

senses.en: (of a rooster) to make a loud, high cry
senses.pattern: the rooster crows / crow at dawn / crow loudly
senses.example: On my uncle's farm, we got up every morning as soon as the rooster [[crowed]].
senses.example_zh: 在舅舅的農場，每天早上公雞一啼叫我們就起床。

senses.en: a disagreement between people
senses.pattern: settle their differences / put aside differences / have their differences / resolve differences
senses.example: The two roommates finally settled their [[differences]] and agreed to share the housework equally.
senses.example_zh: 兩位室友終於化解了意見分歧，同意平均分擔家事。
senses.note: 此義常用複數 differences

senses.en: the amount by which one number is greater than another
senses.pattern: pay the difference / make up the difference / split the difference
senses.example: If you change to a larger room, you only need to pay the [[difference]] in price.
senses.example_zh: 如果您換到較大的房間，只需補足價格的差額。

senses.en: to lower your head or body quickly to avoid something
senses.pattern: duck down / duck behind a wall / duck under a branch / duck out of sight
senses.example: The tall visitor had to [[duck]] to avoid hitting his head on the low doorway.
senses.example_zh: 那位高個子訪客得彎身低頭，才不會撞到低矮的門框。

senses.en: to avoid a difficult question or duty
senses.pattern: duck a question / duck the issue / duck responsibility
senses.example: The spokesperson [[ducked]] every question about the delay and talked only about future plans.
senses.example_zh: 發言人迴避所有關於延誤的問題，只談未來的計畫。

senses.en: having the ability or strength needed for something
senses.pattern: be equal to the task / equal to the challenge / prove equal to the job
senses.example: Though new to the job, Maria proved [[equal]] to the task of managing the whole team.
senses.example_zh: 瑪麗亞雖然是新手，卻證明自己能勝任管理整個團隊的工作。
senses.note: 固定搭配 be equal to＋名詞／V-ing

senses.en: to be as good as someone or something else
senses.pattern: equal sth in beauty / equal a record / no one can equal sb
senses.example: Few modern buildings can [[equal]] the old temple in beauty and fine detail.
senses.example_zh: 很少有現代建築在美感和精細程度上比得上這座古廟。
senses.note: 名詞 equal＝同等的人；have no equal 無與倫比

senses.en: a group of related animals, plants, or languages
senses.pattern: the cat family / a language family / belong to the same family
senses.example: Lions and tigers both belong to the cat [[family]], yet their hunting habits are quite different.
senses.example_zh: 獅子和老虎都屬於貓科，但牠們的獵食習性大不相同。

gsat.sentence: Jackdaws are birds in the crow [[family]] often found in the English countryside.

senses.en: a set of rooms to live in; an apartment
senses.pattern: rent a flat / share a flat / a two-bedroom flat / a block of flats
senses.example: While studying in London, she shared a small [[flat]] with two other exchange students.
senses.example_zh: 在倫敦念書期間，她和另外兩位交換學生合住一間小公寓。
senses.note: 英式用法；美式用 apartment

senses.en: (of a tire) without enough air; (of a drink) not fizzy
senses.pattern: a flat tire / go flat / flat soda
senses.example: We were late for the picnic because our car got a [[flat]] tire on the highway.
senses.example_zh: 我們野餐遲到了，因為我們的車在公路上有個輪胎洩了氣。

senses.en: (of a fee or rate) fixed and not changing
senses.pattern: a flat fee / a flat rate / a flat fare
senses.example: The museum charges a [[flat]] fee of five dollars, no matter how long visitors stay.
senses.example_zh: 這間博物館收取五美元的固定費用，不論遊客停留多久。

senses.en: to make something grow or become stronger
senses.pattern: fuel fears / fuel speculation / fuel demand / fuel the growth of
senses.example: Rumors on social media [[fueled]] fears that the factory would close before the end of the year.
senses.example_zh: 社群媒體上的謠言助長了恐懼，大家擔心工廠會在年底前關閉。
senses.note: 英式拼法過去式為 fuelled

gsat.sentence: And Africa [[fueled]] another interest in him: photography.
Each year, tens of millions of animals, including dogs and cats, needlessly suffer and die to [[fuel]] the fur industry.

senses.en: to lead or be in charge of a group
senses.pattern: head a team / head a committee / head a department / be headed by
senses.example: Dr. Lin was chosen to [[head]] the research team studying the new virus.
senses.example_zh: 林博士獲選率領研究這種新病毒的團隊。

senses.en: to go in a particular direction
senses.pattern: head for the exit / head home / head north / head back to
senses.example: As dark clouds gathered, the hikers decided to [[head]] back to the campsite at once.
senses.example_zh: 烏雲聚攏時，健行者決定立刻朝營地走回去。

senses.en: the person in charge of a group or organization
senses.pattern: head of state / head of the department / the head of the family
senses.example: The [[head]] of the research center announced a new scholarship for outstanding science students.
senses.example_zh: 研究中心的負責人宣布設立一項新獎學金，獎勵傑出的理科學生。

gsat.sentence: They have also rung in times of celebration and of mourning, announcing such events as royal weddings and coronations of kings, as well as funerals of [[heads]] of state.
In 1884, Carl Elsener, [[head]] of the Swiss knife manufacturer Victorinox, seized that opportunity with both hands, and designed a soldier’s knife that the army loved.

senses.en: importance or significance (formal)
senses.pattern: a matter of great import / of little import / of no import
senses.example: The committee met to discuss matters of great [[import]] to the future of the school.
senses.example_zh: 委員會開會討論對學校未來極具重要性的事務。
senses.note: 正式用語；重音在第一音節

senses.en: the meaning of something, especially when not stated directly
senses.pattern: the full import of / grasp the import of / the import of his words
senses.example: It took him several days to grasp the full [[import]] of what the doctor had said.
senses.example_zh: 他花了好幾天才領會醫生那番話的全部含意。

senses.en: to succeed in getting a job, contract, or role
senses.pattern: land a job / land a contract / land a role / land a deal
senses.example: After dozens of interviews, she finally [[landed]] a job at a well-known design studio.
senses.example_zh: 經過數十次面試，她終於得到一家知名設計工作室的工作。

senses.en: to put someone in a difficult or unpleasant situation
senses.pattern: land sb in trouble / land sb in jail / land sb in the hospital
senses.example: Skipping classes again and again finally [[landed]] him in serious trouble at school.
senses.example_zh: 一再翹課終於使他在學校陷入大麻煩。

senses.en: a country or region (literary)
senses.pattern: a foreign land / a distant land / their native land / a land of opportunity
senses.example: The old sailor loved to tell stories about his adventures in distant [[lands]].
senses.example_zh: 那位老水手喜歡講述他在遙遠國度的冒險故事。

gsat.sentence: The islands soon attracted traders from different [[lands]].
King Henry V of England is credited with having invented the first true passport, as a way of helping his subjects prove who they were in foreign [[lands]].

senses.en: a group of baby animals born at one time
senses.pattern: a litter of puppies / a litter of kittens / the smallest of the litter
senses.example: Our neighbor's dog gave birth to a [[litter]] of six puppies last night.
senses.example_zh: 我們鄰居的狗昨晚生了一窩六隻小狗。
senses.note: cat litter＝貓砂

senses.en: to be scattered over a place; (passive) to be full of
senses.pattern: be littered with mistakes / be littered with examples / litter the floor
senses.example: His essay was [[littered]] with spelling mistakes, so the teacher asked him to write it again.
senses.example_zh: 他的作文充斥著拼字錯誤，所以老師要他重寫。
senses.note: 多用被動 be littered with

gsat.sentence: Soon after their conversation, the guru died and the sow did have a [[litter]] of four little pigs.
I’m going to be the fourth piglet of its next [[litter]].

senses.en: relating to physical things or money, not the spirit
senses.pattern: material comforts / material wealth / material needs / the material world
senses.example: He gave up [[material]] comforts and moved to a mountain village to live a simpler life.
senses.example_zh: 他放棄物質的享受，搬到山村過更簡單的生活。

senses.en: a person who is suitable for a particular role
senses.pattern: leadership material / college material / management material
senses.example: Calm, fair, and well organized, Jenny is real leadership [[material]], so we elected her class president.
senses.example_zh: 珍妮冷靜、公正又有條理，是當領袖的人才，所以我們選她當班長。
senses.note: 此義不可數，前面常接名詞

senses.en: an action taken to achieve something
senses.pattern: a smart move / a bold move / make a move / a move to cut costs
senses.example: Lowering ticket prices was a smart [[move]] that brought thousands of new visitors to the museum.
senses.example_zh: 調降票價是明智的舉措，為博物館帶來數千名新訪客。

senses.en: to cause someone to do something
senses.pattern: move sb to do sth / be moved to act / feel moved to help
senses.example: The photos of hungry children [[moved]] many viewers to donate money to the relief fund.
senses.example_zh: 那些飢餓孩童的照片促使許多觀眾捐款給救濟基金。
senses.note: 另義：I move that…＝（會議中）提議

senses.en: a remark or comment about something you have noticed
senses.pattern: make an observation / an interesting observation / observations on sth
senses.example: The guest speaker made a witty [[observation]] about how teenagers talk less but text more.
senses.example_zh: 那位客座講者發表了一句風趣的評論，說青少年話變少、訊息卻傳得更多。

senses.en: (of a feeling or smoke) to make someone weak or helpless
senses.pattern: be overcome with emotion / be overcome with grief / be overcome by smoke / be overcome by fumes
senses.example: When her name was announced as the winner, she was [[overcome]] with emotion and could not speak.
senses.example_zh: 當她的名字被宣布為得獎者時，她激動得受不了，說不出話來。
senses.note: 多用被動 be overcome by/with

senses.en: how well a person or organization does something
senses.pattern: academic performance / job performance / a strong performance / improve performance
senses.example: Getting enough sleep can greatly improve students' academic [[performance]], according to a recent study.
senses.example_zh: 根據最近一項研究，睡眠充足能大幅提升學生的學業表現。

senses.en: how well a machine or vehicle works
senses.pattern: engine performance / high performance / battery performance / improve the performance of
senses.example: The new battery design improves the [[performance]] of electric cars in extremely cold weather.
senses.example_zh: 新的電池設計提升了電動車在嚴寒天氣中的性能。

gsat.sentence: Jack’s excellent [[performance]] in last week’s game has erased all the doubts about his ability to play on our school basketball team.
There is, however, a significant gap between such beliefs and the actual effect of weather on people’s [[performance]] at work.

senses.en: low in quality; not good
senses.pattern: poor quality / poor eyesight / in poor health / a poor memory
senses.example: Because of [[poor]] lighting in the hall, many students found it hard to read the exam paper.
senses.example_zh: 由於禮堂的照明不佳，許多學生覺得很難看清考卷。

senses.en: having very little of a particular thing
senses.pattern: be poor in nutrients / poor in natural resources / poor in vitamins
senses.example: The soil here is [[poor]] in nutrients, so farmers must add fertilizer every season.
senses.example_zh: 這裡的土壤缺乏養分，所以農民每一季都得施肥。
senses.note: be poor at＝不擅長

gsat.sentence: The absence of smiles stemmed partly from the attempt to hide their decayed teeth caused by [[poor]] dental hygiene.
Some hotels may not provide air conditioning in the capsules, leading to [[poor]] air flow.

senses.en: a special chance that makes you feel honored
senses.pattern: it is a privilege to / have the privilege of / a great privilege / a rare privilege
senses.example: It was a great [[privilege]] to meet the scientist whose books had inspired me since childhood.
senses.example_zh: 能見到那位著作從小啟發我的科學家，真是莫大的榮幸。

gsat.sentence: Ladies and gentlemen, it is my [[privilege]] to speak to you all on this special occasion.

senses.en: to tell a customer the price you will charge
senses.pattern: quote a price / quote sb a price / quote sb $500 for
senses.example: The mechanic [[quoted]] us eight thousand dollars for repairing the engine, which seemed far too high.
senses.example_zh: 修車師傅向我們報價八千元修理引擎，這似乎貴得離譜。

senses.en: a statement of how much a job will cost
senses.pattern: get a quote / ask for a quote / a free quote
senses.example: Before choosing a moving company, we asked three of them for a written [[quote]].
senses.example_zh: 選定搬家公司之前，我們請其中三家提供書面報價。
senses.note: 亦作 quotation

senses.en: to make a rule or control less strict
senses.pattern: relax the rules / relax restrictions / relax controls / relax a ban
senses.example: The school decided to [[relax]] its dress code and allow students to wear sneakers on Fridays.
senses.example_zh: 學校決定放寬服裝規定，允許學生星期五穿運動鞋。

senses.en: not exact or detailed; approximate
senses.pattern: a rough idea / a rough estimate / a rough draft / a rough guess
senses.example: This is only a [[rough]] draft, so please ignore the spelling mistakes for now.
senses.example_zh: 這只是一份粗略的草稿，所以請先別管拼字錯誤。

senses.en: difficult and unpleasant
senses.pattern: a rough day / have a rough time / a rough start / go through a rough patch
senses.example: She had a [[rough]] first year abroad, struggling with the language and missing her family.
senses.example_zh: 她在國外的第一年很艱難，既要克服語言障礙，又想念家人。

senses.en: (of the sea or weather) wild and stormy
senses.pattern: rough seas / rough weather / a rough crossing
senses.example: The ferry was canceled because the sea was too [[rough]] for a safe crossing.
senses.example_zh: 渡輪停駛了，因為海上風浪太大，無法安全橫渡。

senses.en: to get something, especially after much effort
senses.pattern: secure a job / secure funding / secure a place / secure a victory
senses.example: After months of hard practice, the team finally [[secured]] a place in the national finals.
senses.example_zh: 經過數月苦練，這支隊伍終於爭取到全國決賽的席次。

senses.en: to fasten or fix something firmly
senses.pattern: secure a rope / secure the ladder / secure sth to / secure sth with
senses.example: The climbers [[secured]] the rope to a large rock before going down the cliff.
senses.example_zh: 攀岩者先把繩索繫牢在一塊大岩石上，才沿著懸崖下降。

gsat.sentence: Many animals are known to live and move in groups to [[secure]] food and avoid predators.
Prom night can be a dreadful experience for socially awkward teens or for those who do not [[secure]] dates.

senses.en: not having enough of something
senses.pattern: be short of money / be short on time / in short supply / run short of
senses.example: We are [[short]] of volunteers this year, so each of us has to work longer hours.
senses.example_zh: 今年志工人手短缺，所以我們每個人都得工作更久。

senses.en: suddenly, or before the expected end
senses.pattern: stop short / cut sth short / be cut short
senses.example: The driver stopped [[short]] when a dog ran across the road right in front of him.
senses.example_zh: 一隻狗從他正前方衝過馬路，司機突然停了下來。
senses.note: fall short of＝未達到（目標）

gsat.sentence: But fresh water can be in [[short]] supply in many arid regions of the world such as Saudi Arabia, where there are limited water resources.
Since we are [[short]] of manpower in the factory, it is very likely we will hire some people next month.

senses.en: happening without problems or sudden movements
senses.pattern: a smooth flight / a smooth transition / a smooth start
senses.example: Thanks to careful planning, the move to the new campus was surprisingly [[smooth]].
senses.example_zh: 多虧事前仔細規劃，搬遷到新校區的過程出乎意料地順利。

senses.en: to remove problems and make something easier
senses.pattern: smooth the way for / smooth the path to / smooth over differences
senses.example: The exchange program helped [[smooth]] the way for closer ties between the two schools.
senses.example_zh: 這項交換計畫有助於消除障礙，為兩校更緊密的關係鋪路。

gsat.sentence: Normally, the birds enjoy a [[smooth]] flight together as a group when “commuting” between two locations, such as from their nesting site to their feeding ground.

senses.en: to notice someone or something, often suddenly
senses.pattern: spot a mistake / spot the difference / spot sb in a crowd / be spotted doing
senses.example: A sharp-eyed student [[spotted]] a mistake in the textbook and reported it to the teacher.
senses.example_zh: 一位眼尖的學生發現課本裡有個錯誤，並向老師反映。

senses.en: a difficult situation
senses.pattern: in a tight spot / in a tough spot / put sb on the spot
senses.example: Losing his passport abroad put Kevin in a tight [[spot]], but the embassy quickly helped him.
senses.example_zh: 在國外遺失護照使凱文陷入困境，幸好大使館很快伸出援手。
senses.note: put sb on the spot＝使某人難堪

gsat.sentence: Zoe was just 2 weeks old when she was [[spotted]] wandering in a village market near Kenya’s Tsavo National Park in December 1995.
A month after their release, the whales were [[spotted]].

senses.en: not familiar; not known or seen before
senses.pattern: a strange city / a strange land / a strange face / be strange to sb
senses.example: Arriving alone in a [[strange]] city at midnight, she had no idea where to find a hotel.
senses.example_zh: 半夜獨自抵達一座陌生的城市，她完全不知道要去哪裡找旅館。
senses.note: 名詞 stranger＝陌生人

gsat.sentence: Tom: Who do you ask in a [[strange]] town?
The native greeted the travelers in a peculiar language which was [[strange]] to them.

senses.en: used to ask what would happen if
senses.pattern: Suppose (that) ... / Suppose you were ... / supposing (that) ...
senses.example: [[Suppose]] you lost your phone on a trip—how would you contact your family?
senses.example_zh: 假使你在旅途中弄丟了手機，你要怎麼聯絡家人？
senses.note: 置於句首；亦可用 supposing

senses.en: holding a position at that time in the past
senses.pattern: the then president / the then mayor / her then boyfriend
senses.example: The bridge was opened in 1950 by the [[then]] mayor, who called it a symbol of hope.
senses.example_zh: 這座橋在一九五〇年由當時的市長主持啟用，他稱之為希望的象徵。
senses.note: 只用於名詞前，常與 the 連用

senses.en: (of light, sound, or news) to move or spread
senses.pattern: sound travels / light travels / news travels fast / travel at the speed of
senses.example: Sound [[travels]] much faster through water than through air, which helps whales communicate.
senses.example_zh: 聲音在水中傳播得比在空氣中快得多，這有助於鯨魚彼此溝通。

senses.en: an idea of the future; the ability to plan it wisely
senses.pattern: a leader with vision / a clear vision / a vision of the future / share a vision
senses.example: The founder had a clear [[vision]] of a school where every child could learn at their own pace.
senses.example_zh: 創辦人有個清楚的願景：一所讓每個孩子都能照自己步調學習的學校。

senses.en: a picture in your mind or a dream
senses.pattern: have a vision of / have visions of / see sth in a vision
senses.example: The night before the exam, he had [[visions]] of himself staring at a blank answer sheet.
senses.example_zh: 考試前一晚，他腦中浮現自己盯著空白答案卷的景象。

gsat.sentence: In 1977, he bought a piece of rocky wasteland with the [[vision]] of growing trees on it.
Camake said, “They told me afterward that through our performance, they had a [[vision]] of our country, our village, without having to visit it.

senses.en: to send money electronically from one bank to another
senses.pattern: wire money / wire sb $500 / wire funds to an account
senses.example: His parents [[wired]] him some money so that he could pay the hospital bill abroad.
senses.example_zh: 他的父母電匯了一些錢給他，讓他能支付在國外的醫藥費。

senses.en: to connect something to an electrical system
senses.pattern: wire a house / wire a plug / be wired to / be wired for sound
senses.example: The electrician [[wired]] the new classroom so that every desk had its own power outlet.
senses.example_zh: 電工替新教室裝設線路，讓每張書桌都有自己的插座。

quiz.stem: The sudden rise in online shopping during the pandemic ______ the demand for delivery workers, and thousands of new positions were created.
quiz.explain_zh: fuel＝助長、刺激。網購暴增刺激了對外送人員的需求。

quiz.stem: Worried that graduation trips were becoming too expensive for some families, the school placed a ______ of five thousand dollars on the cost per student.
quiz.explain_zh: ceiling＝上限。學校為畢業旅行每位學生的費用設定五千元上限。

quiz.stem: I don't need exact figures yet; just give me a ______ estimate of how many guests will attend the school anniversary party.
quiz.explain_zh: rough＝粗略的、大致的。不需確切數字，只要粗略估計出席人數。

quiz.stem: As the number of new infections kept falling, health officials decided to ______ travel restrictions and reopen the border to tourists.
quiz.explain_zh: relax＝放寬（規定、限制）。感染人數下降，官員放寬旅遊限制。

quiz.stem: Living alone after retirement, Mr. Wang adopted a dog from the shelter because he wanted some ______ in his quiet apartment.
quiz.explain_zh: company＝陪伴。王先生退休後獨居，想要有狗作伴。

quiz.stem: With the dry season lasting longer than usual, the island is running ______ of fresh water, and residents are asked to save every drop.
quiz.explain_zh: short＝短缺的。乾季拉長，島上的淡水快不夠用了。

quiz.stem: Thanks to her fluent English and impressive internship experience, Amy ______ a position at an international airline right after graduation.
quiz.explain_zh: land＝得到（工作）。Amy 一畢業就在國際航空公司得到職位。

quiz.stem: The founder of the online bookstore was a woman of great ______, who predicted decades ago that people would one day shop from their phones.
quiz.explain_zh: vision＝遠見。創辦人很有遠見，數十年前就預測到手機購物。

quiz.stem: The heat wave that swept across the continent last summer ______ thousands of lives, mostly those of elderly people living alone.
quiz.explain_zh: claim＝奪走（性命）。去年夏天的熱浪奪走數千條人命。

quiz.stem: It is a great ______ for me to stand here today and receive this award on behalf of all the volunteers.
quiz.explain_zh: privilege＝榮幸。能代表全體志工上台領獎是莫大的榮幸。
